# Welcome ! {.unnumbered}

Hello and welcome to my page on Remote Sensing. This page is an online learning diary for CASA Remotely Sensing Cities and Environments 25/26. This website contains a record of my week-by-week learning, including summary of key concepts, practical applications, reviews on academic literature and relevant web sources, as well as reflections and discussions on learnt concepts and techniques.

## About me

I am a current master’s student at the Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA), University College London (UCL) pursuing MSc, Urban Spatial Science. I hold a bachelor’s degree in BSc, Planning and Real Estate from the University of Manchester in 2022-2025.

## In this Learning Diary

Each chapter will be covering contents taught in the corresponding week:

1.  Introduction
    -   Getting started with remote sensing, this introduction will go through types of sensors, spatial resolutions and practical data pre-processing with Lisbon as the study area.
2.  Sensor
    -   Looking at Sentinel-1, the slides will provide a summary of the sensor, its mission, technical specifications, key objectives and applications, benefits and limitations, and reflections
3.  Correction
    -   Explores preprocessing corrections and enhancements through Hong Kong as a study area, includes mosaicking of Landsat 8-9 tiles, NDVI, GLCM texture analysis, and PCA
4.  Policy
